info.title: STRATOS source authority required by AKB
info.description: Source-document-intake authority plus the additive official-sources contract. Official sync 1.1.0 is authored by STRATOS and awaits AKB contract synchronization and joint acceptance; it does not activate production ingestion.

503.description: Required authority, scanner or ingestion unavailable

post.description: STRATOS implementation required. Recompute request_hash over all request members except request_hash using recursively key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON. Verify actual source record, revision, parent, attachment bytes/hash, actor token and effective policy/metadata. No echo-only authorization. Return nonce-bound decision with expiry >now and <=60 seconds.

get.description: Read current approved collection projections. An authorized person retains the existing collection discovery flow. The sole official sync client sees only czech-law after fresh central approval, grant, policy and active person validation. No personal Authorization header is needed for the service path.

200.description: Approved collections; service response contains only czech-law.

400.description: Invalid request shape or resource identifier.

401.description: Missing/invalid bearer, invalid signature/issuer/expiry, or official-sync subject configuration unavailable.

403.description: Denied exact service identity, collection, operation, URL, central grant, active owner/gestor, approval or mandatory public/TLP/organization policy.

409.description: Stale/ambiguous active collection revision or changed individually approved evidence.

post.description: Idempotently prepare a preapproved source. czech-law preparation is exclusive to svc-akb-official-source-sync using its exact OAuth service subject, client_id, azp, exact two-audience set [stratos-official-sources, akl-api] and live centrally approved grant. Interactive preparation continues for other collections. The service may not approve sources, choose another collection, expand the URL allowlist, change policy, act as a person or call generic governance operations.

200.description: Approved source metadata, including mandatory explicit TLP:CLEAR and organization audience.

400.description: Invalid request shape or resource identifier.

401.description: Missing/invalid bearer, invalid signature/issuer/expiry, or official-sync subject configuration unavailable.

403.description: Denied exact service identity, collection, operation, URL, central grant, active owner/gestor, approval or mandatory public/TLP/organization policy.

409.description: Stale/ambiguous active collection revision or changed individually approved evidence.

422.description: The exact allowlisted source lacks individual central evidence approval, or its requested version is unverified, future, before first legal effectivity, or has invalid official metadata; nothing is prepared.

503.description: Official version metadata unavailable, redirected, wrong content type, malformed JSON, oversized, or total eight-second evidence deadline exceeded.

sourceService.description: Existing fixed service:akb governance credential; source service is NOT the authority transport.

sourceActor.name: X-STRATOS-Actor-Authorization
sourceActor.description: Separate current person bearer including Bearer prefix.

officialSourcePerson.description: Current interactive person bearer with organization-scoped akb:manage_document AND akb:publish_public. Human preparation remains supported for collections other than czech-law. A person may list approved collections, but cannot prepare czech-law.

officialSourceSync.description: OAuth 2.0 client_credentials token from the configured OIDC_ISSUER_URL. Require the exact configured AKB_OFFICIAL_SOURCE_SYNC_SUBJECT_ID as sub; BOTH client_id and azp must equal svc-akb-official-source-sync; aud must be the exact unordered two-element array [stratos-official-sources, akl-api], with neither duplicates nor additional audiences. No personal token, fallback claim aliases, realm-role grant, policy-service credential or arbitrary service client is accepted. STRATOS also requires the active centrally approved official-source-service-grant for this exact identity, collection revision and operation.

SourceIntakeSourceDocument.title: SourceDocument
SourceIntakeSourceDocument.description: ArchFlow organization_unit intake requires an explicit source-authority handoff. governance_scope.id, gestor_unit, accountability.gestor(kind organization_unit).id and the sole organization_unit policy audience scope ID must match exactly. The source authority revalidates the active canonical unit at every boundary.

SourceIntakeSourceIntakeInformationPolic.description: A source authority decision must bind the exact canonical policy hash.
SourceIntakeSourceIntakeInformationPolic.title: SourceIntakeInformationPolicyBinding

exp.description: Must be current; token signature, issuer and JWT validity are verified independently of this illustrative claim schema.

OfficialSourcePrepareRequest.description: All eight keys are mandatory, including null effectiveFrom/effectiveTo when applicable; no extra keys. Every supplied value must match active approved source metadata/current collection revision. For czech-law the exact dated source URL and effective interval are checked against freshly fetched bounded official e-Sbírka JSON-LD metadata. No document body is fetched and no arbitrary source is approved.

OfficialSourceSyncPrepareRequest.description: Only a dated sourceUrl beneath one of the 100 exact canonical act URLs is eligible. Its YYYY-MM-DD suffix and supplied effectiveFrom/effectiveTo must match a nonfuture version listed in freshly verified official má-znění JSON-LD metadata at https://opendata.eselpoint.gov.cz/esel-esb/eli/cz/sb/{year}/{number}, including version-level effective interval evidence; dates before the centrally reviewed manifest firstEffectiveFrom are denied. URL syntax alone is not authority. Title must equal the approved manifest title. The initial collection revision is 1. The caller cannot invent legal effectivity, approve a new act or choose a metadata host.

OfficialSourceRootProfile.description: Owner and person gestor are active internal STRATOS subjects. For czech-law both resolve to the active jiri.volek@voldzi.cz person; the service subject is never substituted for either role. The sourceRecordId hashes collectionId + newline + canonicalUrl, and sourceGovernedResourceId identifies the individually approved source.

OfficialSourcePreparationResponse.description: Replay with unchanged authoritative metadata returns the same approved source identity, policy/hash and lifecycle dates. czech-law version evidence is rechecked on every preparation and admission; changed effective intervals fail closed rather than being silently accepted. This is approved preparation metadata, not a document-admission ALLOW or a content/publication result. AKB allocates its own root metadata revision in the existing admission flow.
